ios.desc:
TAKE YOUR FONT LIBRARY EVERYWHERE.

Font Wizard Pro turns your iPhone, iPad, or iPod touch into a clean, portable font workflow for real projects. Browse the web for fonts. Download OTF, TTF, OpenType, and TrueType files. Import your own font files. Preview each typeface, compare styles, build project sets, tag what matters, export ZIP files, and transfer fonts to your Mac or PC over Wi-Fi.

Stop hunting through messy folders. Stop guessing from file names. Keep the right font ready.

BUILT FOR

- Designers building font sets for logos, posters, brand kits, apps, and websites.
- Marketers managing typefaces for campaigns, ads, landing pages, and client work.
- Developers keeping font files ready for apps, sites, prototypes, and interface tests.
- Content creators comparing styles for thumbnails, videos, titles, and posts.
- Students collecting fonts for projects, print work, and presentations.
- Small business owners keeping brand fonts close without a folder hunt.
- Writers and makers testing how words feel before choosing a style.

FROM FONT CHAOS TO FONT CONTROL

Font work slows down when files live everywhere: websites, downloads, email, Files, old folders, and past projects. You remember the look, but not the name. You saved it, but not where. You download the same font again. Then again.

Font Wizard Pro gives every typeface a home. It helps you save, search, sort, preview, compare, export, and transfer your library from one clear place.

PRO TOOLS FOR REAL FONT WORK

BUILD A CLEAN FONT LIBRARY
Import font files, preview styles, add tags, assign fonts to projects, repair missing items, and use install or activation options on compatible fonts and devices. On iOS, install fonts using a configuration profile.

BROWSE, SAVE, AND DOWNLOAD
Use the built-in browser to visit font sites and send useful files into downloads. Add font URLs by hand. Search your queue. Retry or resume failed items. Remove duplicates before they clutter.

PREVIEW THE FONT, NOT JUST THE NAME
A file name cannot show mood, shape, weight, spacing, or feel. A live preview can. See how each font looks before it reaches a design, deck, site, app, or client file.

COMPARE WITH REAL WORDS
Place typefaces side by side with your own sample text. Change size. Adjust alignment. Test a headline, label, sentence, or short note. Choose the font that reads best.

ORGANIZE WITH TAGS AND PROJECTS
Tag fonts by style, mood, client, brand, platform, or use case. Create project sets. Keep a logo set ap
